input.title: That's My Gut Breaking Down
input.lyrics:
[Intro: vocals start immediately]
[Hook]
Crusty eyes every morning, that's my gut breaking down
Lickin' my paws every night, that's my gut breaking down
Shedding that never slows down, that's my gut breaking down too
Lick, lick, wipe, wipe, she don't know what to do

[Verse 1]
Every night I'd lick my paws, she'd tell me, "Stop"
I could not stop, I licked until the lights went off
Every morning wiped my eyes, then coffee in her cup
Like the crust was just routine, like it never added up
Every week she vacuumed all my fur off the couch
Stared down at the pile like, "Why won't this slow down?"
Sprays, shampoos, she switched my food two times
I watched her try everything, but nothing changed the signs
She thought that's just how I was, that's just me
And I had no way to tell her, no, it's not, believe me

[Pre-Chorus]
All three were coming from the same place, my gut
Good bacteria crash and the filter's shut
Toxins out my eyes every night while I slept
Inflammation in my paws, my coat had nothing left
She was treating what she saw
But the source never changed at all

[Verse 2]
Then one night she found it, a greens powder, Iron Paws
Didn't chase the symptoms, went straight after the cause
Probiotics to rebuild the balance that I lost
Chlorella flushed the toxins out, whatever the cost
Chicory root to steady up my gut from inside
Thursday night she mixed it in, didn't say much, no big why
Peanut butter flavor, wow
I finished the bowl before she even put it down

[Bridge]
A few weeks went by, she came to wipe my eyes
And she stopped, there was nothing left to wipe
Looked down at my paws, no red at all
Ran her hand along my coat and just held on
Sat down next to me, said, "I'm sorry, I didn't know"
I licked her hand, we were good, we were good

[Outro]
Human grade, vet formulated
Three thousand five-star reviews on Amazon
Ten thousand dog owners joined last month alone
You just didn't know what the signs meant
But now you do
Iron Paws, the link is below
Your pup's been waiting on you
[End]
